dialogue.content: おはようございます。今日はよろしくお願いします。お時間になったら始めます。
dialogue.English: Good morning. Thank you for coming today. We'll start when it's time.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you, I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。今日はお越し頂きありがとうございます。初めに、あなたの年齢、性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming today. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 14歳　女子です
dialogue.English: I'm a 14-year-old girl.

dialogue.content: 教えて頂きありがとうございます。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: なんかどうしたら良いのかわかんない
dialogue.English: I just don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: ええ、それは苦しいですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, that must be difficult.

dialogue.content: なんかだるいなーって
dialogue.English: I just feel kind of blah.

dialogue.content: もう少しどんなことで悩まれてるのか教えてもらってもいいですか？
dialogue.English: Would you mind telling me a little more about what's troubling you?

dialogue.content: ええ、そのように思われるんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how you're feeling.

dialogue.content: どんな時にそのように思うことが多いのですか？
dialogue.English: When do you tend to feel that way most often?

dialogue.content: 彼氏があんま連絡くれないとか
dialogue.English: Like, my boyfriend doesn’t really text me much.

dialogue.content: うん、うん、それは寂しいね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, that must be lonely.

dialogue.content: 他にありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else?

dialogue.content: ライン既読スルーとかするし
dialogue.English: And he leaves my LINE messages on read and stuff.

dialogue.content: ええ、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: どのように感じてますか？
dialogue.English: How does that make you feel?

dialogue.content: つまんない
dialogue.English: It's no fun.

dialogue.content: うん、うんそんなふうに思ってるんですね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, so that's how you're feeling.

dialogue.content: 彼はどんな人なの？
dialogue.English: What kind of person is he?

dialogue.content: 友達の彼氏とかもっとマメだしいいなーって
dialogue.English: My friends’ boyfriends are more attentive, and I’m like, “that’s nice…”

dialogue.content: もう別れた方が良いの？
dialogue.English: Should I just break up with him?

dialogue.content: そうなんだ、悲しくなりますよね．
dialogue.English: I see, that must make you sad.

dialogue.content: どうでしょうか。そのことだけで判断するのは難しいと思うんだけど
dialogue.English: Well, I think it's difficult to decide based on that alone.

dialogue.content: あなたはどうしたいの？
dialogue.English: What would you like to do?

dialogue.content: 先生はどう思う？😱
dialogue.English: What do you think? 😱

dialogue.content: うん、もう少しお話しを聞いてもいいかな？？
dialogue.English: Hmm, would it be okay if I asked you a few more questions?

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 彼は同じ学校の人なの？
dialogue.English: Does he go to the same school?

dialogue.content: そう
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: うん、学校で会ってる時、彼とどんな話をするんですか？
dialogue.English: When you see him at school, what do you two usually talk about?

dialogue.content: 最近は学校オンラインばっかだから話してないラインメッセばっか
dialogue.English: Lately school’s mostly online, so we haven’t really talked—it's mostly just LINE messages.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, I see.

dialogue.content: LINEではどんな話をするのかな
dialogue.English: What kind of things do you talk about on LINE?

dialogue.content: 面白い動画交換したり、飼ってる射ぬの話くらいかも
dialogue.English: We exchange funny videos or talk about my pet dog, something like that.

dialogue.content: 犬だ(笑)
dialogue.English: I mean, dog (lol).

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、そうなんだ！
dialogue.English: Oh, I see!

dialogue.content: 最後に直接会ったのはじゃあいつなのかな
dialogue.English: So, when was the last time you saw each other in person?

dialogue.content: 二週間前位かな
dialogue.English: About two weeks ago, I think.

dialogue.content: うん、うん、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: でもあんま楽しそうでなかったかなーとか
dialogue.English: But I kind of felt like he didn’t seem to be having much fun.

dialogue.content: ええ、そう思ったんですね
dialogue.English: I see, that's what you felt.

dialogue.content: どんなことからそんなふうに思ったの？
dialogue.English: What made you feel that way?

dialogue.content: 目が笑ってない的な感じ
dialogue.English: Like, his eyes weren’t smiling.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうやって感じると悲しくなるよね
dialogue.English: Yes, it must be sad to feel that way.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 他に彼に対して思ったことはどんなことがありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else you've noticed about him?

dialogue.content: 少し太ったなーとか(笑)
dialogue.English: Like, he’d put on a bit of weight (lol).

dialogue.content: うんうん、そうなんだ！
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, I see!

dialogue.content: あなた自身は彼に会った時どんな気持ちになった？
dialogue.English: How did you feel when you saw him?

dialogue.content: 会うまでは楽しみだったけど、なんかちょっと冷めたのもあった
dialogue.English: I was looking forward to it until we met, but then I felt a bit cooled off.

dialogue.content: そうかそうか、そんな気持ちになったのはやっぱり彼の態度なのかな？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you think you felt that way because of his attitude?

dialogue.content: そうかもでもまだ付き合って２ヶ月位だし
dialogue.English: Maybe. But we’ve only been dating for about two months.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そうなんだ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, I see.

dialogue.content: 私もすごい好きだったのかよくわかんないかも
dialogue.English: I'm not even sure if I was ever that into him.

dialogue.content: もう別れた方がいーかなー？
dialogue.English: Maybe I should just break up with him?

dialogue.content: うん、そう思うんですね、
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what you're thinking.

dialogue.content: 彼とはどのようなきっかけで付き合うことになったの？
dialogue.English: How did you two start dating?

dialogue.content: オンラインゲームの話で盛り上がって
dialogue.English: We got really into talking about online games.

dialogue.content: うんうん、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: それがきっかけあと顔が好みだった😍
dialogue.English: That was how it started, and I also liked his face. 😍

dialogue.content: うん！そうなんだ！
dialogue.English: Right! I see!

dialogue.content: あなた自身は彼とどうなれたらいいなって思うことある？
dialogue.English: What do you wish your relationship with him was like?

dialogue.content: よくわからない先生はどうしたらいいと思う？
dialogue.English: I'm not sure. What do you think I should do?

dialogue.content: そっかそっか、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: わたしはあなた自身が彼といて楽しかったり、彼を好きという気持ちがあるなら別れる必要はないんじゃないかなって。
dialogue.English: Well, I think that if you enjoy being with him and still have feelings for him, then there's no need to break up.

dialogue.content: 彼はもしかしたらシャイで連絡が遅かったり、他のことを考えてたりして、余裕がないのかもしれないし
dialogue.English: He might be shy, slow to reply, or preoccupied with other things and just not have the emotional bandwidth right now.

dialogue.content: どう思う？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: うーん　よくわかんないーどうやったらわかるの？
dialogue.English: Hmm, I don’t really know—how can I find out?

dialogue.content: うんうん、難しいよね
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, it's difficult, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 彼に自分のことが好きなのか聞いたことはある？
dialogue.English: Have you ever asked him if he likes you?

dialogue.content: ないよー🤣
dialogue.English: Nope 🤣

dialogue.content: そっかそっか、勇気がいるもんね、彼から好きという気持ちが伝わる瞬間はある？
dialogue.English: I see. It takes courage, doesn't it? Are there moments when you can feel that he likes you?

dialogue.content: そんなに会えてないからよくわからないなー
dialogue.English: We haven't been able to see each other much, so I'm not really sure.

dialogue.content: そっかそっか、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、2ヶ月前から授業はオンラインなの？
dialogue.English: By the way, have your classes been online for the past two months?

dialogue.content: 夏休み前は結構授業あったかな
dialogue.English: Before summer break, we had quite a few in-person classes.

dialogue.content: 学校行ってた
dialogue.English: I was going to school.

dialogue.content: でも夏休み終わってからオンラインばっか
dialogue.English: But after summer break ended, it’s been mostly online.

dialogue.content: うんうん、彼と付き合ってからはやっぱりほとんどオンライン授業なのかな？
dialogue.English: I see. So, since you started dating him, your classes have been mostly online?

dialogue.content: そー　だからあんまリアルで会ってないかも😅
dialogue.English: Yeah, so we haven't really seen each other in person much. 😅

dialogue.content: それは寂しいよね。。。
dialogue.English: That must be lonely...

dialogue.content: コロナっていうこともあって、それが原因でお互いの気持ちがなかなかうまくいかなかったりすることもあるかもしれないよね
dialogue.English: With COVID and everything, that might be part of why it’s been hard for you two to connect emotionally.

dialogue.content: ほんとコロナで全部つまんなくなった　もうやだ
dialogue.English: Seriously, COVID has made everything boring. I’m so over it.

dialogue.content: うん、ストレスほんとに溜まるよね。直接会えないとなると、やっぱりLINEでの連絡になるし、それが少ないとなるともっと悲しいと思う
dialogue.English: Yeah, it's really stressful. When you can't meet in person, you have to rely on LINE, and if that contact is infrequent, I imagine it's even sadder.

dialogue.content: あなた自身がいま1番悩んでることって、彼と別れた方がいいのかってこと？
dialogue.English: Is the main thing you're worried about right now whether or not you should break up with him?

dialogue.content: よくわかんない
dialogue.English: I'm not sure.

dialogue.content: 先生はどう思う？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: うんうん、話をこれまで聞いてて、あなたは彼のこと好きなんじゃないかって思ったんだけど、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. Listening to you so far, I got the impression that you do like him, but...

dialogue.content: やっぱり連絡が少なかったり会う機会がなかったりすると気持ちも冷めてしまうこともあると思う、けどいつも彼のことを優しく気遣っていて、あなた自身が彼と向き合ってるということが伝わったんだけど
dialogue.English: I think it's natural for feelings to cool when there's not much contact or chances to meet. But it also came across that you're always so kind and considerate of him, and that you're really trying to face this relationship.

dialogue.content: どうかな？
dialogue.English: How does that sound to you?

dialogue.content: そんなに私優しくないかもだけど
dialogue.English: I might not be that kind, though.

dialogue.content: なんか毎日イライラしてるし
dialogue.English: I just feel irritable every day.

dialogue.content: そうかな？彼と会った時に、彼が楽しそうじゃないかも…って人の感情に目を向けられるのは優しい心を持ってるからこそだと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: Do you really think so? I think being able to notice someone else's feelings, like when you thought he might not be having fun, is a sign that you have a kind heart.

dialogue.content: イライラするのは自然だよね。どんなことに対して1番イライラするの？
dialogue.English: It’s natural to feel irritated. What do you find yourself getting most irritated about?

dialogue.content: 彼氏のとこもあるけど、なんか毎日つまんないし
dialogue.English: It's partly about my boyfriend, but also, every day just feels boring.

dialogue.content: むなしーなーって
dialogue.English: It just feels so empty.

dialogue.content: うんうん、コロナになってから人と積極的に会えないし、孤独感を感じたりするよね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. Since the pandemic started, it's been hard to really see people, and that can make you feel lonely, can't it?

dialogue.content: コロナの終わりって誰も知らないし、いつ戻れるんだろうって不安にもなると思う。
dialogue.English: No one knows when it will end, and I'm sure you feel anxious wondering when things will ever go back to normal.

dialogue.content: どう思う？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: なんか毎日グレーみたいな色な感じがする
dialogue.English: It feels like every day is the color gray.

dialogue.content: 親もイライラしてる
dialogue.English: My parents are irritable too.

dialogue.content: ええ、うん。モヤモヤしてるんだね。
dialogue.English: I see. So there’s this hazy, unsettled feeling.

dialogue.content: そうか、両親のどんな行動や言動からそう思うの？
dialogue.English: I see. What actions or words from your parents make you think that?

dialogue.content: お父さんがコロナで家で仕事するようになってずっと家にいるし、私もいるし
dialogue.English: Because of COVID, my dad started working from home, so he's always here, and so am I.

dialogue.content: うんうん、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: お母さんが大変なんだって
dialogue.English: My mom says it's hard on her.

dialogue.content: お父さんもなんか文句増えたし
dialogue.English: And my dad complains more now, too.

dialogue.content: みんなストレスが溜まって、切羽詰まる気持ちになるよね。
dialogue.English: Everyone's stress is building up, and it can feel like you're at a breaking point.

dialogue.content: 家広くないから空気がヤバい
dialogue.English: Our house isn't big, so the atmosphere is tense.

dialogue.content: そっかぁ…居場所がないと感じてしまったりするよね
dialogue.English: I see… it can feel like there’s no place for you, can't it?

dialogue.content: そんな中でも周りの仲間を試みたりすることができるあなたは素敵だね。
dialogue.English: It's wonderful that even in a situation like that, you're able to try and consider those around you.

dialogue.content: どういう意味？
dialogue.English: What do you mean?

dialogue.content: 余裕がない中でも周りの人のことを大変だろうなって考えたりすることができるって素敵だと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: I think it's wonderful that even when you don't have much emotional space yourself, you can still think about how difficult things must be for others.

dialogue.content: そうかな
dialogue.English: You think so?

dialogue.content: うん、私はそう思うよ。コロナは誰のせいでもないし、私たちの力で止めることもできないよね。だからこそ、
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s how I see it. COVID isn’t anyone’s fault, and it’s not something we can stop by ourselves. That’s why...

dialogue.content: 未来を不安に思うより今できることに目を向けたいなって私は思うんだけどどう思う？
dialogue.English: I think it's better to focus on what we can do now, rather than worrying about the future. What do you think?

dialogue.content: 何ができるの？
dialogue.English: What can I do?

dialogue.content: うん、あなた自身でいま悩んでること。彼のことに関してもだし、家族のことでも。何か自分ができること探してみようか。
dialogue.English: Okay, let's think about the things you're worried about right now, both with your boyfriend and your family. How about we try to find something you can do?

dialogue.content: どうやって探すの？
dialogue.English: How do we find it?

dialogue.content: 一緒に考えてみよう！
dialogue.English: Let's think about it together!

dialogue.content: 彼のことに関しては
dialogue.English: About your boyfriend—

dialogue.content: あなたが言ってたように付き合って2ヶ月ということと、コロナが原因で会えないこともあってまだまだ知らないことも多そうだよね。
dialogue.English: As you said, you've only been dating for two months, and you can't meet because of the pandemic, so it seems like there's still a lot you don't know about each other.

dialogue.content: 連絡がなかなか無かったり、既読無視されると悲しい気持ちになるけど、そんな時にあなた自身の寂しい思いや悲しくなったこと思ってることを伝えるってのはどうなのかな。
dialogue.English: It's sad when he doesn't contact you or leaves your messages on read, but what about telling him how lonely and sad that makes you feel?

dialogue.content: もしかしたら彼もおんなじ悩みを持ってるかもしれないし、他になにか考えてるかもしれないと思ったんだけど、どう思う？
dialogue.English: He might be having the same worries, or he might just have something else on his mind. What do you think?

dialogue.content: でもまたメッセスルーされたらしんどいし怖い
dialogue.English: But it would be hard and scary if he just leaves that message on read again.

dialogue.content: そう思うんだね。されると怖いし勇気がいるよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. It's scary and takes courage.

dialogue.content: でも、結果がどうであれまずは今の気持ちを伝えることは出来るんじゃないかなって。無視されたらまた一緒に考えよう。
dialogue.English: But, regardless of the outcome, I think you can at least try to convey your current feelings. If he ignores it, we can think about what to do next together.

dialogue.content: なんて言えばいいの？
dialogue.English: What should I say?

dialogue.content: うん、あなたが私に上手に伝えてくれたように連絡が少ないことや既読スルーされたこと、本当は寂しい気持ちになったよ。ってことを伝えればいいんじゃないかな？
dialogue.English: Well, just like how you explained it so well to me, how about telling him something like, 'When you don't message me much or you leave my messages on read, it makes me feel really lonely.'?

dialogue.content: どうかな？
dialogue.English: How does that sound?

dialogue.content: このままコピペして使っていい？
dialogue.English: Can I just copy and paste that?

dialogue.content: もちろん、あなたの気持ちが彼に伝わるならどうぞ使ってください
dialogue.English: Of course. If it helps get your feelings across to him, please go ahead and use it.

dialogue.content: 彼に届くことわたしも祈ってるね。
dialogue.English: I’ll be hoping it gets through to him, too.

dialogue.content: ありがとう
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: もしよかったらまたここでどうなったか、また教えてください。
dialogue.English: If you'd like, please come back and tell me how it went.

dialogue.content: 家族のことに関してなんだけど、少し話してもいい？
dialogue.English: Regarding your family, is it alright if we talk about that for a bit?

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Sure.

dialogue.content: お時間ありがとう。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: ずっと家にいるとなかなか気持ちが晴れなかったりすることが多いと思うんだ。そんな時に空気を入れ替えて外に散歩するっていう方法もあるし家族の空気が重い時はあなたが率先的に明るく話しかけてみるとかお手伝いしてみるとかでもずいぶん空気が変わると思います。
dialogue.English: I think it's often hard to feel cheerful when you're stuck at home all the time. When that happens, getting some fresh air by going for a walk can help. And when the atmosphere at home feels heavy, I think it could change a lot if you took the initiative to start a cheerful conversation or offer to help.

dialogue.content: やはり人間はネガティブな環境になるとマイナス思考になりやすいのでさっき言った未来を不安に思うよりは今できることをすることが心理学ではいいという話も周りにあなたならできるんじゃないかなって。
dialogue.English: People tend to think negatively in negative environments, so as I said before, focusing on what you can do now rather than worrying about the future is psychologically beneficial. I think you're the kind of person who could do that, not just for yourself but for those around you as well.

dialogue.content: どう思うかなあ
dialogue.English: What do you think about that?

dialogue.content: むずい(笑)でもイライラしててお手伝いさぼってたかも
dialogue.English: That's hard (lol). But maybe I have been slacking on my chores because I've been so irritable.

dialogue.content: 難しかったね、ごめんね、
dialogue.English: That was a difficult suggestion, I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: そかそか、そう思うんだ！イライラって1番人に伝染しやすいよね
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what you think! Irritation is one of the most contagious feelings, isn't it?

dialogue.content: お父さんも運動不足だから散歩誘ってみる
dialogue.English: My dad isn’t getting enough exercise either, so I’ll try inviting him on a walk.

dialogue.content: うん、うん、そうなんだね！ぜひやってみてください。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, that's a great idea! Please give it a try.

dialogue.content: 環境や空気を変えてみると思考が変わったりすることもあります。また家族とコミュニケーションを取る機会にもなるしね
dialogue.English: Sometimes, changing your environment or the atmosphere can change your way of thinking. It also becomes an opportunity to communicate with your family.

dialogue.content: 前向きにあなたが考えてくれてとても嬉しか思います。人のことを考えることができる優しい心を持っているあなたならできそうですね。
dialogue.English: I'm so happy that you're thinking positively. With a kind heart like yours that can think of others, I'm sure you can do it.

dialogue.content: またダメだったら話せる？
dialogue.English: If it doesn't work out, can I talk to you again?

dialogue.content: もちろんです。ここであなたのこといつでも待ってますね。ぜひ少しづつでいいので今日あなたが決めた　今できること　やってみてください
dialogue.English: Of course. I'll always be here waiting for you. Please, even just a little at a time is fine, so try doing the things you decided on today that you can do now.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: あなたのこと応援してます
dialogue.English: I'm rooting for you.

dialogue.content: それではそろそろお時間でした。話し足りないことなどありますか？
dialogue.English: Well, it looks like our time is almost up. Is there anything else you wanted to talk about?

dialogue.content: いっぱいあるけど、なんか落ち着いた
dialogue.English: There's a lot, but I feel calmer now.

dialogue.content: うん、それを聞いてわたしも嬉しいです。今日はありがとう。また一緒に話しましょうね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, I'm happy to hear that. Thank you for today. Let's talk again soon.

dialogue.content: それではこちらで失礼致します。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Then, I'll sign off here. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: (お疲れ様です。お時間すみません、ありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Great work. Sorry for going over time, and thank you.)

dialogue.content: お疲れ様でしたありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Great work, thank you so much.
